name: Impenitence
overview: The Scriptures reveal impenitence as a stubborn refusal to fear and obey God, exemplified by Pharaoh and his servants who repeatedly hardened their hearts despite clear judgments, as seen in Exodus 9:30 and 9:34. Even after witnessing God's power and mercy, Pharaoh's resistance intensified, culminating in God's sovereign act of hardening his heart (Exodus 10:27). This impenitence led to opposition against God's people, demonstrating the grave consequences of persistent rebellion against the Lord's commands (Exodus 14:5). Through these passages, we understand that impenitence is not merely sin but a willful hardening against God's gracious call to repentance.
